gpu_scope: Whole GPU including background. Per-flight GPU attribution unavailable; baseline subtraction is not causal attribution.

reference_comparison.scope: Same-mode predeclared exploratory reference; not an isolated causal ablation

strict_recovery_audit.scope: Source metadata and completed log episodes only; not physical safety proof

command.scope: Observed messages; includes DDS/observer jitter and intentional command holds, not producer callback latency

odometry.scope: Observed messages; includes DDS/observer jitter and intentional command holds, not producer callback latency

demand_reason_audit.scope: Cumulative final outcomes after renewal; early-gated ticks and final partial report interval excluded

goal_identity_audit.scope: Explicit creation-ID linkage and exercised coverage; not proof that every repeat may safely be suppressed

headless_parameter_audit.scope: Composed nodes only; remote parameter services/events unavailable under opt-in; external mission node unchanged

small_pool_timing.scope: Finite-run engineering guard; command message gaps include intentional holds and are not callback gaps
